title: Prepare the glyph 0.1.0 release: README release status, CHANGELOG, package metadata (DEC-303 (a20))
description: DEC-303 (a20), operator answer to dec-13m90z3: ship glyph 0.1.0 with Python support. Prepare the release through the normal flow: README states the measured Python recall and precision (click 68/80 = 0.8500 precision 68/69; requests 57/65 = 0.8769 precision 57/57) as stated limits, a CHANGELOG, package description and keywords true to TypeScript plus Python. No tag, no publish (tier 3), no promotion to main (DEC-93), no tuning against the spent samples; GCLI-86 stays open and any pass claim needs a fresh blind sample. On landing, report the proposed tag name and the exact SHA it will peel to.

package.json description and keywords are true to TypeScript and Python; version is 0.1.0; no dependency, workflow or lockfile change
bun run check, check:package and pinned lore check --strict are green; no tag, publish or main promotion
